name: Useful Meshtastic Config Options
snippet: Precision allows you to specify how accurate of a location fix to broadcast. Since some Meshtastic device have GPS included they have the ability to obtain your precise location down to a few meters.

name: Position and Administrative Modules | meshtastic/firmware
snippet: The PositionModule broadcasts GPS positions to the mesh network and processes incoming position updates, while the AdminModule provides secure remote configuration and control of device settings. For information about other modules such as telemetry and sensors, see Telemetry and Sensor Modules.

name: How Meshtastic Data works Protocol Buffers (protobufs)
snippet: Meshtastic uses Protobufs to define and serialize structured data exchanged between devices in the mesh network. These messages are organized into different modules, each handling specific types of data.
